user.title: Diesel Heater Controller
user.description: Sign in with a WebUI account that has the Settings permission. Your password is only used once to fetch an API key and is not stored.

mfa.title: Authentication code
mfa.description: This account uses MFA. Enter the 6-digit code (or a recovery code).

error.invalid_auth: Incorrect username or password, or the user lacks the Settings permission
error.unexpected_response: That address answered, but not like a heater controller. Check the IP address and that the controller is running the latest firmware.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the Home Assistant log for details.
